content_sections.heading: About Kokrajhar University
content_sections.text: Kokrajhar University is a university in Kokrajhar, in the Bodoland Territorial Council (BTC) area of Assam, and the notice is issued by the Office of the Registrar. The posts are teaching and support posts for the university's Physical Education Course, run in its Department of Sports & Physical Education.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: All 14 posts are in the Department of Sports & Physical Education. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The 55% condition for the professor posts is "55% marks or its equivalent grade i.e. B in the seven-point scale of letter grades O, A, B, C, D, E, F as per UGC norms". Master's degree in Physical Education (M.P.Ed./M.P.E.) with 55% marks or its equivalent grade, i.e. B in the seven-point scale of letter grades O, A, B, C, D, E, F as per UGC norms. Ph. D in the field of Physical Education. Eight years teaching experience out of which five years experience in an institute/college department of physical education. Any other stipulation prescribed by the UGC/affiliating body/State Govt. from time to time for the positions of principal shall be mandatory. M.P.Ed. degree or its equivalent with at least 55% marks or its equivalent grade i.e. B in the seven-point scale of letter grades O, A, B, C, D, E, F as per UGC norms. A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution industry, excluding the period of Ph.D. research. Evidence of published work and a minimum of 5 publications as books and/or research/policy papers. Any other stipulation prescribed by UGC/Affiliating Body/State Govt. from time to time for the position of Associate Professor shall be mandatory. M.P.Ed. degree or its equivalent with 55% marks or its equivalent grade i.e. B in the seven-point scale of letter grades O, A, B, C, D, E, F as per UGC norms. Any other stipulation prescribed by UGC/Affiliating Body/State Govt. from time to time for the position of Assistant professor shall be mandatory. Master's degree/Bachelor's degree in physical education with specialization in at least one game/sport (as applicable) OR Diploma/PG diploma in coaching in a sport (as applicable). Post Graduate / Post Graduate Diploma in Yoga. Post Graduate / Post Graduate Diploma in concerned subject. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The notice states that the salary will be negotiable; no pay level, pay scale or fixed amount is printed for any of the six posts. The notice does not mention allowances, the tenure or whether the appointments are regular or contractual.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kokrajhar University Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted by email only at this stage. The interview is the selection stage named in the notice, and its date will be communicated later. Prepare the application along with a detailed CV mentioning educational qualifications. Attach the supporting documents. Send the application by e-mail to [email protected] within 21 November 2026 . Wait for the date of interview, which will be communicated later. On the day of the interview, submit a self-attested hard copy of the application along with the CV and supporting documents. Office of the Registrar: Kokrajhar University, Kokrajhar, BTC, Assam - 783370. Contact No: 8638471995 (M).

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Kokrajhar University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 14 posts: 1 Head of the Department, 2 Associate Professors, 6 Assistant Professors, 3 Sports Trainers, 1 Yoga Trainer and 1 Dietician in the Department of Sports & Physical Education.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted by email within 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: An M.P.Ed. degree or its equivalent with 55% marks or equivalent grade B in the UGC seven-point scale, plus any other stipulation prescribed by UGC/Affiliating Body/State Govt.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Head of the Department post?
faq.answer: M.P.Ed./M.P.E. with 55% marks (or grade B), a Ph.D in Physical Education, and eight years of teaching experience, five of them in an institute/college department of physical education.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for Sports Trainers?
faq.answer: A Master's or Bachelor's degree in physical education with specialization in at least one game/sport, or a Diploma/PG diploma in coaching in a sport, as applicable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The notice states that the salary will be negotiable; no pay scale is printed.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email the application with a detailed CV and supporting documents to [email protected] within 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview?
faq.answer: The date of the interview will be communicated later. Candidates must bring a self-attested hard copy of the application, CV and supporting documents on that day.

faq.question: Q9. What qualification is needed for the Yoga Trainer and Dietician posts?
faq.answer: Yoga Trainer needs a Post Graduate or Post Graduate Diploma in Yoga; Dietician needs a Post Graduate or Post Graduate Diploma in the concerned subject.
